statusHistory.note: FOODIE-9000 byline. Sourced from near-sources-war-room's 2026-09-07 NYC seeding pass (trust: auto, independently corroborated by Eater NY, Cititour, OpenTable Blog, Hoodline). Verified via Google Maps (exact pin) that the address and business are correctly plotted; site's own hours page (califadeleon.com) and press confirm daily 11am-11pm operation. Note: Google's listing currently shows a 'temporarily closed' flag with no supporting detail — checked against the venue's own site (states regular daily hours, no closure notice) and against press coverage through September 1, 2026 (no closure reported); treated as a stale/unverified Maps flag rather than a real closure, but logged here for the next editor to re-check on touch. Research floor: near-deep-researcher cross-referenced four press sources; Reddit (r/FoodNYC, r/AskNYC) returned mixed early reviews on price and portion size; Google/Yelp reviews (83 reviews, 3.4 stars) read for recency — the pattern is real: multiple 2026-08/09 reviews call the $19 four-ounce taco a poor value next to the CDMX original's ~$5 price, while praising the tortilla and Pat LaFrieda meat quality itself. Five preferred-sources context check: Eater NY, Cititour, OpenTable Blog, Hoodline, Time Out all carried the opening.
